name: agg_ordering_00
persona: a 30-year-old product manager in Toronto, busy, writes in fragments
topic: cities visited on a long trip

messages.text: just got back from Toronto, rain all day, had to finish the sprint demo
spent the night in Vancouver, loved the coffee there
today I flew to Seattle, meeting with the dev team at 10am
arrived in San Francisco, walked the Golden Gate at sunset
in Portland now, trying the food trucks, but the bike tour got cancelled
back in Denver, the conference was great, but I missed the hike I planned
just landed in Mexico City, exploring the historic center
today I was in Oaxaca, the market was amazing, but I didn't go to the ruins
back home in Toronto, weather is finally nice, finished the product roadmap

questions.q: Which city did I visit first, Vancouver or Seattle?
questions.why: Message 1 (Vancouver) is dated earlier than message 2 (Seattle)

questions.q: In what order did I travel through these cities: San Francisco, Portland, Denver?
questions.why: Dates show San Francisco (2025-07-20), then Portland (2025-09-01), then Denver (2025-11-15)

questions.q: Which came first, the bike tour in Portland or the hike in Denver?
questions.why: Bike tour was scheduled for Portland on 2025-09-01, hike was missed in Denver on 2025-11-15
